answer: The violet counter is kept in vine and jade exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 24 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 24 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4289 identities would post 4661 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
